segments.normalizedSource: ```c // Initialize this pointer using mmap() with the MAP_JIT flag. static void *jit_region; struct jit_code { void *instructions; ptrdiff_t entry_point; size_t instructions_length; } enum jit_code_safety { JIT_CODE_VALID, JIT_CODE_INVALID, }; // Ensure that the JIT code is safe to execute. enum jit_code_safety validate_jit_code(struct jit_code *code); int jit_writing_callback(void *context) { struct jit_code *code = (struct jit_code *)context; if (validate_jit_code(code) == JIT_CODE_VALID) { memcpy(jit_region, code->instructions, code->instructions_length); return 0; } else { return -1; } } ```
